The 16th Gamcheon Culture Village Alley Festival

○ Period: October 31-November 1, 2026

○ Hours: 10:00-18:00

○ Venue: Gamcheon Culture Village

○ Hosted by: Saha-gu, Gamcheon Culture Village Residents Council

○ Website: https://www.gamcheon.or.kr/

- How to get there : Toseong Station (Metro line 1), exit 6. Take minibuses 1-1, 2 or 2-2 and get off at Gamjeong Elementary School. Walk straight to the entrance of village.
